attributes.board_name: New Jersey State Board of Social Work Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs from providers approved by NASW or NASW state chapters, ASWB (ACE)-approved providers, courses approved through the NJ Continuing Education Course Approval Program / CE Approval Collaborative, and other sources listed in N.J.A.C. 13:44G-6 (Board-recognized approval entities, N.J.A.C. 13:44G-6.7).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed in the second year of the biennial period: half the credits (at least 10 clinical, 3 ethics, 2 social and cultural competence).
rules.carryover: Up to 8 surplus credits may be carried into the next biennial period.
rules.audit_note: Attendance verified by certificate of attendance or instructor statement (N.J.A.C. 13:44G-6.5); the Board audits CE.

topics.who: All licensees: prescription opioid drugs incl. risks and signs of abuse, addiction and diversion (N.J.A.C. 13:44G-6.2(e))

rules.notes: At least 20 of the 40 credits must be directly related to clinical practice. Biennial period begins September 1. Credits count toward only one category. Hours read from the official NJ Register adoption texts posted by the Board.
rules.rule_quote: An LCSW shall complete a minimum of 40 credits of continuing education, of which at least 20 of the 40 credits shall be in courses or programs directly related to clinical practice…
